name: Nom Nom Edible Co | 200mg Gummies | Strawberry Kiwi Energy (4:1 THC:CBG)
description: Introducing "Nom Nom Edible Co's" dynamic energy booster: our 200mg THC edible infused with the stimulating essence of yerba mate. Delight in the harmonious fusion of sweet strawberry and tangy kiwi, invigorating your palate with each delicious bite. Enhanced with a touch of CBD, this edible provides a balanced lift, promoting clarity and focus alongside the energizing effects of THC. Fuel your day with vitality and flavor with Nom Nom Edible Co, where every bite is a step towards enhanced productivity and enjoyment.
